etcd snapshot larini MinIO ga avtomatik yuborasiz
Patroni+etcd+HAProxy+keepalived arxitekturasini chizasiz
depth: Nexus: npm-proxy + npm-hosted + npm-group; PyPI; Docker (connector port); apt
Mijozlarni sozlash: .npmrc, pip.conf, containerd mirror
Rollar, foydalanuvchilar, CI uchun token
Cleanup policy va compact blob store vazifasi
etcd zaxira nega hayotiy: klaster holatining yagona manbai
etcdctl snapshot save; RKE2: etcd-snapshot-schedule-cron, retention, etcd-s3-* parametrlari
Tiklash: rke2 server --cluster-reset --cluster-reset-restore-path; boshqa server node larni qayta qo'shish
Zaxirani sinash — tiklab ko'rilmagan zaxira zaxira emas
Patroni to'liq arxitekturasi: 3 PG+Patroni, 3 etcd, 2 HAProxy + keepalived VIP
Har bir komponent nima uchun; portlar (5432, 8008, 2379/2380, 5000/5001)
patroni.yml bo'limlari: scope, restapi, etcd3, bootstrap.dcs, postgresql, tags
Bootstrap jarayoni: birinchi node initdb, qolganlari pg_basebackup
Setup 1-qism: etcd klaster va Patroni node lar

glossary.def: Ma'lumotlar bazasining bir lahzadagi to'liq nusxasi
Eski artefaktlarni avtomatik o'chirish qoidasi
RKE2 da etcd ni bitta a'zoli klasterga qaytarish amali
Ishlab turgan PostgreSQL dan to'liq fizik nusxa oluvchi vosita

labs: Nexus da npm va Docker proxy repo sozlang va mijozdan sinang
RKE2 etcd snapshot → MinIO; klasterni snapshotdan tiklang
3 node etcd + Patroni klaster ko'taring
breakfix: etcd tiklangach boshqa server node lar qo'shila olmayapti
Patroni "waiting for leader to bootstrap"
interview: etcd ni qanday zaxiralaysiz va tiklaysiz?
Patroni klasterida har bir komponent vazifasi?

lessons.title: Postgres HA: HAProxy, switchover. Replikatsiya rejimlari. Barman, pgBackRest. Yakun
lessons.summary: Ma'lumotni yo'qotmaslik san'ati va kurs xulosasi.
objectives: HAProxy orqali RW/RO yo'naltirishni sozlaysiz va switchover sinaysiz
Async, sync va quorum replikatsiya kompromisslarini tushuntirasiz
WAL arxivlash va PITR ni amalga oshirasiz
RPO/RTO ni hisoblaysiz
Final loyihaga tayyorsiz
depth: HAProxy: option httpchk GET /primary (5000) va /replica (5001); on-marked-down shutdown-sessions
Switchover testi: patronictl switchover; ulanishlar uzilishi va ilova retry si
WAL ichki: har o'zgarish avval WAL ga; LSN; checkpoint; crash recovery
Async replikatsiya: commit kutmaydi — failover da oxirgi tranzaksiyalar yo'qolishi mumkin (RPO > 0)
Sync replikatsiya: synchronous_standby_names, synchronous_commit darajalari (off, local, remote_write, on, remote_apply)
Sync kompromissi: kechikish oshadi; standby o'chsa yozuv to'xtaydi
Quorum sync: ANY 1 (s1, s2); Patroni synchronous_mode va synchronous_mode_strict
Standby sync holatlari: pg_stat_replication (sync_state, lag)
Zaxira turlari: mantiqiy (pg_dump) vs fizik (base backup + WAL)
PITR: base backup + WAL arxiv → recovery_target_time
pgBackRest: stanza, full/diff/incr, parallel, S3 (MinIO) repo, tekshirish
Barman: streaming arxiv, barman-cloud
RPO (qancha ma'lumot yo'qotish mumkin) va RTO (qancha vaqtda tiklanish)
Replika ≠ zaxira (DROP TABLE ham replikatsiya bo'ladi)
Kurs yakuni: bilimlar xaritasi va keyingi qadamlar

glossary.def: Write-Ahead Log — o'zgarishlar avval yoziladigan jurnal
Log Sequence Number — WAL dagi pozitsiya
Point-In-Time Recovery — istalgan vaqt nuqtasiga tiklash
Recovery Point Objective — yo'qotilishi mumkin bo'lgan ma'lumotning eng ko'p hajmi (vaqtda)
Recovery Time Objective — tiklanish uchun ruxsat etilgan eng ko'p vaqt
Commit replika tasdig'ini kutadigan rejim
PostgreSQL uchun zaxira va tiklash vositasi
Xotiradagi o'zgargan sahifalarni diskka yozish nuqtasi

labs: HAProxy orqali yuk ostida switchover qiling va xatolar sonini o'lchang
Sync replikatsiyani yoqib, replika o'chganda nima bo'lishini kuzating
pgBackRest → MinIO: to'liq zaxira, jadvalni o'chiring, PITR bilan tiklang
breakfix: Sync rejimda yagona standby o'chdi — barcha yozuvlar osilib qoldi
PITR ishlamaydi: WAL arxivda bo'shliq bor
interview: Sinxron va asinxron replikatsiya farqi va kompromisslari?
